objective: Introduce a bounded deterministic keyset-pagination primitive for River CRM created-at cohorts without changing legacy bounded callers or insurance reporting semantics yet.

cursor.nextPagePredicate: created_at < cursor.createdAt OR (created_at = cursor.createdAt AND relationship_id > cursor.relationshipId)

rules: Validate range, page size, cursor timestamp, and cursor relationship identity before D1 access.
Set hasMore only from the bounded pageSize plus one probe.
Emit nextCursor only when hasMore is true.
Derive nextCursor from the last relationship actually returned.
Never issue an unbounded relationship query.
Do not migrate insurance reporting consumers in this slice.
Do not add or execute a schema migration in this slice.
